text.tspan: Median of five independent run medians, seven samples per path; error bars: minimum–maximum run medians.
Same exclusive node, CPU affinity and NUMA policy for both paths. Queue-event intervals include lookup.
Compiled matmul on 2 × AMD EPYC 7713 (128 physical cores total; SMT disabled)
Fixed 128-thread OpenMP team; tile layout and numBlocks tuned jointly
